messages:
Maya: Heads-up — playbook automation misfiring for onboarding-step `send-setup-email`. Saw ~12% failure rate since 02:00 UTC, a lot of them 400s from the rules engine. Suspect lookup-table entropy after yesterday's canonicalization tweak. @Noah @Priya :eyes:
Noah: looking. grabbed logs -> playbook-bot shows lots of `key not found: canonical_company_type` when resolving rule predicates.
playbook-bot: [error] run_id=rbk-20260322-99 rule=send-setup-email predicate=company_type_match status=skipped reason="missing_canonical_key"
Priya: We changed company_type canonical mapping yesterday to consolidate values. New mapping keys are `startup,scaleup,enterprise`. Many accounts still have `early,growth` in legacy field, mapping didn't include those aliases.
Maya: ah ok — that would cause the predicate to skip and then fallback to fallback-route which triggers the error. Any quick mitigation?
Liam: temp mitigation: add a guard in the playbook to require canonical_company_type exists before running the step. quick PR pushed to staging: `cs/playbooks/guards/require_canonical_company_type`.
Ava: +1 on guard. But we still need to backfill canonical values for accounts created in last 90 days. Otherwise playbooks will keep hitting a lot of skipped branches.
Noah: I can run a targeted backfill. Plan: 1) dry-run for accounts created in last 30 days (non-destructive) 2) evaluate misfires delta 3) run full backfill during low traffic window (sun 03:00 UTC). Command I'll use:
```
python tools/backfill_canonical.py --from=legacy_company_type_aliases.csv --filter "created_at>=2026-01-01" --dry-run
```
Priya: share sample of alias file — we should include older values: `early` -> `startup`, `growth` -> `scaleup`, `seed` -> `startup`, `mid-market` -> `enterprise`.
Noah: posted dry-run summary: 4,512 accounts would be updated, predicted playbook hit reduction ~10-14%. Full output: https://redwood-internal.storage/reports/cs/backfill/dryrun-1728000000.csv
Maya: good. Please tag any edge cases where mapping is ambiguous — we'll add to mapping table.
Ava: I'll follow up and add fallback mapping rules; also adding a playbook metric to console for `skipped_due_to_missing_canonical_key` so we can detect future entropy.
Liam: I'll run the dry-run to staging at 01:00 PT and post results here. If green, Noah can run the full backfill during the planned window.
Noah: created incident ticket CS-INC-847 and linked run. https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/browse/CS-INC-847 :shipit:
Maya: thanks everyone. After full backfill, let's schedule a 15-min postmortem to capture why the alias list wasn't comprehensive before deploy.
Ava: putting notes + follow-ups in docs page: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/Canonical+Mapping+Runbook
playbook-bot: [info] scheduled job backfill_canonical --window=sun-03:00-04:00 UTC owner=Noah
Maya: closing loop — please ping me if any unexpected failures during backfill. :thumbsup:
